bips.title: Static Per-Output Miner Fee
bips.description: Bitcoin Improvement Pre-Proposal: a consensus-enforced fixed satoshi fee to miners for every new non-coinbase output, pricing permanent UTXO-creation costs that relay policy cannot bind.

related.title: Full Cost of Running a Bitcoin Node

bips.title: Dynamic Escalation of the Per-Output Miner Fee
bips.description: Bitcoin Improvement Pre-Proposal: optional EMA and 25th-percentile fee escalation on top of the static per-output miner fee so the deterrent does not decay over decades.
